import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize output ports
    fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    standard = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    # Track which rows have been matched
    matched = pd.Series([False] * len(claims), index=claims.index)
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1
    rule1_mask = (~matched) & (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1)
    fast_track = pd.concat([fast_track, claims[rule1_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched |= rule1_mask
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000
    rule2_mask = (~matched) & (claims["amount"] > 10000)
    high_value = pd.concat([high_value, claims[rule2_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched |= rule2_mask
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500
    rule3_mask = (~matched) & ((claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500))
    manual_review = pd.concat([manual_review, claims[rule3_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    matched |= rule3_mask
    
    # Default port: unmatched rows go to standard
    default_mask = ~matched
    standard = pd.concat([standard, claims[default_mask][["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Ensure proper dtypes
    for df in [fast_track, high_value, manual_review, standard]:
        if len(df) > 0:
            df["claim_id"] = df["claim_id"].astype("int64")
            df["amount"] = df["amount"].astype("float64")
            df["photos_attached"] = df["photos_attached"].astype("int64")
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": fast_track,
        "claims_high_value": high_value,
        "claims_manual_review": manual_review
    }
